column3: MT 4:2. Close to the Aramaic; “imaginings” is rendered “the thoughts.”
MT 4:4. Close to the Aramaic; “magicians, conjurers, Chaldeans, astrologers” is rendered “the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers.”
MT 4:5. NKJV renders “a spirit of the holy gods” as “the Spirit of the Holy God.”
MT 4:6. NKJV renders “a spirit of the holy gods” as “the Spirit of the Holy God,” and “whom I know” as “because I know.”
MT 4:7. Close to the Aramaic; “the land” is rendered “the earth.”
MT 4:12. Close to the Aramaic; “a fetter” is rendered “a band,” and “with the animals [be] its portion” “let him graze with the beasts.”
MT 4:13. Close to the Aramaic; “its heart” is rendered “his heart,” applying the image to a person.
MT 4:14. Close to the Aramaic; “the command” is rendered “This decision,” and “the affair” “the sentence.”
MT 4:15. NKJV renders “a spirit of the holy gods” as “the Spirit of the Holy God.”
MT 4:16. Close to the Aramaic; “about one moment” is rendered “for a time.”
MT 4:20. Close to the Aramaic; “with the animals of the field [be] its portion” is rendered “let him graze with the beasts of the field.”
MT 4:23. Close to the Aramaic; “the heavens are ruling” is rendered “Heaven rules.”
MT 4:24. Close to the Aramaic; “by right doing” is rendered “by being righteous,” and “whether” “Perhaps.”
MT 4:27. Close to the Aramaic; “a house of a kingdom” is rendered “a royal dwelling.”
